description: A luxurious contemporary outdoor resort terrace photographed at dusk, with a wide establishing view looking across a pool deck. In the foreground, a manicured grass lawn transitions to large-format pale stone pavers bordering an illuminated rectangular swimming pool with turquoise tile. Large round bronze-patinated metal planters hold lush, low-growing ornamental trees or sculpted shrubs at the left, their foliage lit from below with a warm amber glow. The pool deck extends into the background where a pergola-covered outdoor lounge or bar area is lit with warm strip lighting along the slats and rattan barstools line a counter. A second matching pole-mounted rattan fixture is visible further back in the right mid-ground. The sky is deep navy blue, transitioning to dark evening, and the warm amber tones from the landscape lighting create a romantic resort atmosphere. The pool reflects the cool aquamarine light and the surrounding warm glows beautifully. The architecture in the background uses natural stone cladding and warm wood slats. Camera is at standing eye-level, roughly 5–6 feet high, with a wide lens, in an off-center thirds composition showing depth from foreground grass to background lounge.
